title: An urgent concern and petition for XSLT
body:
### Over 20K orthodox Jews rely on XSLT. Do not destroy us.

Greetings.

My name is Schimon Jehudah.

I am an orthodox Jewish man who is affiliated with the orthodox sector, as we call it.

We do not utilize the public internet, yet rather we have our own local networks, similarly to mesh networks.

Our local information networks are mostly operated in Modein Eilit, Jerusalem, Hashmonaim, and Beney Brack, as well as abroad.

We are utilizing HTTP and XMPP to publish content with the Atom Syndication Format; in addition we have recently started to utilize the new system Nostr as it provides us more flexibility. Therefore, we are critically relied on XSLT.

The removal of XSLT and further attempts to abolish it would critically damage us.

Please reopen discussion #11563 about XSLT rather than censoring it; otherwise, a new organization would be established to compete this organization, which would be unfortunate to all of us, as it would cause to more conflicts and unnecessary segregations.

It is very well known that XSLT would allow more flexibility to individuals, rather than having big organizations with further unfair advantage.

Please, do avoid this move, as there are enough people who are smart enough to mobilize in order to promote XSLT without this organization; and they are definitely smarter than me.

The author of this post is a pianist and an attorny at law, and has not formal education in copmuter science. If I know that information, then you should realize that hundreds of thousands do as well.

I have informed my rabbi and several head of kollels and yeshivas about this grave concern, including asking and preparing funds for a new organization to promote XSLT, and we care not what anyone else says.

We intend to collaborate with anyone, incluiding anyone, be it even Christian or Muslim.

This is critical. Please rethink of it. XSLT is vital.

P.S.

It is no secret that there is an organized conspiracy of multi-million "bills-of-exchange" worth organizations to remove XSLT and RSS technologies.

During the early 2000's it was predicted that XML (Atom Syndication Format) would be the standard format to deliver data, and XSLT is intended to customize its visual appearance, yet big organizations have distracted us with the fallacy of HTML5, ,even though XHTML and XML are superior.

Speaking of which, my friends analyses indicate that the ECMAScript (i.e. JS) module XSLTProcessor of "gecko" is probably deliberately malformed in order to disvourage people from utilizing XSLT. This analyses has cost to out yeshiva over 10K sheqels which we could have feed poor families instead, if that module was designed properly instead of being sabotaged by design.

https://openuserjs.org/garage/Why_my_script_doesnt_work_with_Firefox#comment-1810ec600fe

We all save time and money with XSLT.

Please. Please. Please. Listen to us.

@gucci-on-fleek @Phoenix616 @ShadowJonathan @nafmo @duckdotapk @Zergy @nomis @jonsterling
